Venom systems have evolved repeatedly across the animal tree of life. 

## Research directions


## Study systems

The project draws on venomous and non-venomous animal lineages, with a particular interest in cone snails and other animals that use bioactive molecules in prey capture and defense.

::: {.project-callout}
**Methods**

Comparative genomics · Phylogenetics · Transcriptomics · Protein and peptide characterization · Functional assays
